BiblicalUsage: Jalon is named once, among the sons of Ezra in the line of Judah. He stands in the genealogy beside Jether and Mered and Epher, one name in the long record of the tribe.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a single mention is enough for God to remember a man, and Jalon's name is kept because the tribe is kept.
